build_TransformerModel: build a TransformerModel encoder or decoder with configurable heads, layers, and positional embeddings
run_TransformerModel_fwd: run the TransformerModel forward pass with causal attention, source encoding, and KV caching
run_TransformerModel_generate: run greedy or sampled sequence generation from encoder outputs using the TransformerModel decoder
run_TransformerModel_generate_beam: run beam search decoding with joint decoding groups and length penalty on the TransformerModel
create_MultiHeadAttention: create a MultiHeadAttention layer with optional normalized attention and KV caching support
